patch.objective: Overseeing model governance: lifecycle management, versioning, and drift detection/monitoring

sources.cite: PMI Certified Professional in Managing AI (PMI-CPMAI) Examination Content Outline (September 2025): Responsible and Trustworthy AI 15%, Business Needs and Solutions 26%, Data Needs 26%, Model Development and Evaluation 16%, Operationalize 17%
sources.note: Read 2026-11-17 through a summarizing fetch of a training provider's syllabus page that restates the outline in its own words (PMI's PDF did not come up in search). Restated: data evaluation (assess data quality; analyze distributions for bias or gaps; exploratory data analysis); model governance (lifecycle management, versioning and change control, monitor performance and detect drift). The objective wording here is the course seed's; PMI's own wording is to verify.

sources.cite: AWS. SageMaker AI Developer Guide: Data quality (Model Monitor)
sources.note: Read 2026-11-11: the baseline job 'computes baseline schema constraints and statistics for each feature' from 'an input dataset that you provide' (Deequ on Spark); monitoring jobs compare captured data with it. Also: 'Amazon SageMaker Model Monitor is no longer open to new customers. Existing customers can continue to use the service as normal.' The scenario's team is an existing customer.

sources.cite: AWS. SageMaker AI Developer Guide: Model Monitor availability change
sources.note: Read 2026-11-11: no longer open to new customers; existing customers continue as normal; the replacement for new teams is the open-source SageMaker AI monitoring solutions with Amazon QuickSight and Amazon CloudWatch (for lightweight data quality, CloudWatch custom metrics with anomaly detection alarms). The page gives no date for the change.

sources.cite: AWS. SageMaker AI Developer Guide: Schedule expressions for monitoring
sources.note: Read 2026-11-11: 'Hourly: cron(0 * ? * * *)'; 'SageMaker AI only supports hourly integer rates between 1 hour and 24 hours'; there 'could be a delay of 0-20 minutes from the actual requested time to run the execution'.

sources.cite: AWS. SageMaker AI Developer Guide: CloudWatch metrics for Model Monitor
sources.note: Read 2026-11-11: when emit_metrics is Enabled in the baseline constraints file, each feature gets metrics including feature_baseline_drift_{feature_name} in /aws/sagemaker/Endpoints/data-metric (EndpointName and ScheduleName dimensions).

sources.cite: AWS. SageMaker AI Developer Guide: Model quality monitoring
sources.note: Read 2026-11-11: model quality jobs compare predictions 'with the actual Ground Truth labels', merging captured data 'with actual labels that you store in an Amazon S3 bucket'. The page says nothing about how late labels arrive; the 30-60 day chargeback delay is scenario data.

sources.cite: AWS. SageMaker AI Developer Guide: Shadow tests
sources.note: Read 2026-11-11: SageMaker 'routes a copy of the inference requests to it in real time within the same endpoint. Only the responses of the production variant are returned to the calling application'; shadow responses can be logged 'for offline comparison'.
